1. Take the luma.
2. Around each pixel, add up how similar the 37 pixels of the circle are to it. This is the USAN area n.
3. Set the edge response to g - n where n is below g.
4. Find the edge direction from the center of gravity of the USAN, or from its longest axis where it is thin.
5. Keep the pixels whose response is the largest across the edge.
6. Remove edge pieces shorter than the minimum length.
